CAMPAIGN NARRATIVE ARC

SITUATION & THEATRE CONTEXT
PUNTLAND COASTAL AO

THREAT ENTERPRISE — VOLK GROUP & JAS

A rogue Russian PMC enterprise (Volk Group) has established a secretive maritime logistics node in the historic coastal enclave of Eyl, Puntland.

  • Cover Operation: Offshore commercial fishing and anti-piracy maritime security.
  • Smuggling Operations: High-end weaponry including Kornet ATGMs, Igla-S MANPADS, thermal optics, and encrypted military C2 equipment into East Africa.
  • Local Alliance: Brokering assets with regional warlord coalition Jabhat al-Somal (JAS) to build an Anti-Access/Area-Denial (A2/AD) network.

FRIENDLY DIRECTIVE — ODA 3324

US Army Special Forces Operational Detachment Alpha (ODA 3324 / "Viper") operates out of an austere staging base at the Eyl Airfield Plateau (FOB Nomad).

  • Directive: Locate, track, interdict, and dismantle Volk Group's footprint.
  • Strategic Objective: Neutralize threats before advanced air-defense systems become operational across the Horn of Africa.

EXECUTION MECHANICS OVERVIEW

FOUR-PHASE OPERATIONAL FLOW
CONOPS

PHASE I: WATERBORNE INFILTRATION

Launch 1x MH-60 from Eyl Airfield . traverse below radar coverage. Insert at plateau South East of Mines 0479, 0319 (IP SHARK).

PHASE II: LOW-VISIBILITY INGRESS

Establish S&O cliff overwatch position. Navigate foot route through Slum Village & dry wadi washbed. Bypass JAS ridge checkpoints. .

PHASE III: ACTIONS ON OBJECTIVE

Task A: Micro-GPS beacon tagging on Kamaz trucks via low-water line.
Task B: Tactical camera SSE in container office.

PHASE IV: EXFILTRATION

Collapse back to EP DOLPHIN Located in the valley North West of OBJ. Alternate emergency LZ: HLZ WHISKEY TBD

FOUR-PHASE CONCEPT OF OPERATIONS SLIDE 4 / 12

PHASE I: WATERBORNE INFILTRATION

INSERTION AT IP SHARK
WATERBORNE

INFILTRATION EXECUTION

  • Platform: 1x MH-60
  • Launch Point: Eyl Airfield Plateau (FOB Nomad).
  • Profile: Staying as low as possible to avoid radar. 
  • Insertion Point: Plateau South East of Mines, designated IP SHARK.

ACOUSTIC & THERMAL ADVANTAGE

Heavy ocean surf along the southern cliffs provides natural acoustic masking against coastal listening posts. Coastal sea haze limits enemy thermal detection range beyond 300 meters.

PHASE I DETAIL // INFILTRATION SLIDE 5 / 12

PHASE II: LOW-VISIBILITY INGRESS

WADI MOVEMENT & OVERWATCH SETUP
INGRESS

TACTICAL FOOT INGRESS

  • Route: Concealed dismounted movement through a dry wadi washbed.
  • Avoidance: Bypass established JAS militia static checkpoints positioned along the main ridge roads.
  • Formations: Low-profile staggered column maintaining continuous NVG visual scanning.

S&O OVERWATCH POSITION

Establish a Surveillance & Overwatch (S&O) team on the high cliff edge overlooking the Eyl Fishing Port.

  • Monitor guard rotation patterns and technical patrol schedules.
  • Provide direct security overwatch for the infiltration element.
PHASE II DETAIL // INGRESS & S&O SLIDE 6 / 12

PHASE III: TASK A — VEHICLE TRACKING

OBJECTIVE BARNACLE DOCK YARD
TASK A

FLOATING DOCK YARD INFILTRATION

The action element moves along the low-water tide line to bypass port perimeter fencing and sentries.

MICRO-GPS BEACON ATTACHMENT

  • Targets: 2x unmarked Volk Group Kamaz cargo trucks parked near the offloading ramp.
  • Placement: Attach magnetic micro-GPS tracking beacons directly to the rear axles.
  • Objective: Enable long-range satellite tracking of weapons transit routes into inland Puntland.
PHASE III DETAIL // TASK A SLIDE 7 / 12

PHASE III: TASK B — SENSITIVE SITE EXPLOITATION

CONTAINER OFFICE INTEL RECOVERY
TASK B (SSE)

CONTAINER OFFICE PENETRATION

Infiltrate the Port Authority shipping container office used by Volk Group logistics officers as a tactical command node.

INTELLIGENCE TARGETS

  • Manifests & Cargo Logs: Photograph shipping manifests, bills of lading, and custom declarations.
  • Weapons Crate Serial Numbers: Photograph exact serial numbers on sealed Kornet ATGM and Igla-S optics crates.
  • Equipment: High-resolution tactical digital camera with specialized low-light lens attachments.
PHASE III DETAIL // TASK B SLIDE 8 / 12

THE FRICTION & TWIST

OPERATIONAL CONSTRAINTS & THREAT CAPABILITIES
WEAPONS HOLD

STRICT WEAPONS HOLD

No shots are authorized unless compromised. Friendly forces must maintain 100% stealth throughout the objective execution.

THREAT OPTICAL & MOBILE THREATS

  • Volk Group Contractors: Equipped with thermal scopes and Gen 3+ Night Vision Goggles (NVGs).
  • JAS Militia: Patrol outer beach roads and ridge lines in armed technicals.

COMPROMISE CONSEQUENCES

If a shot is fired or friendly presence is detected, the entire regional militia will alert immediately, sealing coastal exits and forcing a chaotic waterborne hot exfiltration under heavy fire.
